## Checklist

- [ ] Tests cover the change, including error cases; coverage stays at or above
      90 %.
- [ ] Documentation is updated (README of the action, ARCHITECTURE.md if the
      release process changes).
- [ ] A changeset describes the change (`pnpm exec changeset`), or an empty one
      for changes without a release.
- [ ] New dependencies meet the dependency criteria in STANDARDS.md.
- [ ] `pnpm run preflight` passes.
